photos.c: The Master and The Apprentice: John Regis takes the baton from 17 year-old Chris Lambert.

Left: Chris Lambert, 17 years of age and here running to a Surrey Championship win, had a marvellous season. He finished up as 5th ranked under 20 in Britain over 100m with 10.61 and 4th ranked over 200m with 21.56. What a prospect!
At Riga, Latvia, Chris Lambert raced to the bronze medal in the European Under 20 Championship 200 metres.
Chris Lambert receives the Bill Merryman Trophy for the Young Belgravian of the year (the first ever recipient) from Coach John Powell.
Above: Onwards and upwards - Chris Lambert won two major gold medals in 2003 to become European U23 Champion at 200m and World Student Champion at 100m.
Above: A purple patch to finish the last match of the 2007 league. Chris Lambert sends Wade Bennett-Jackson away for a sprint relay win.
